scope: Vercel public UI only. All /api/catalog/* requests below were observed as page-generated requests; no direct BFF/API calls were sent.

deployment.shaAttribution: GitHub main SHA was read from the branch API before the browser run. Andres had reported the same SHA as the Vercel FE deployment; the running Vercel runtime SHA was not independently verified.

browser.method: Local Google Chrome controlled with Playwright

scenarios.name: initial-page
scenarios.visible: 2 productos; Mostrando 1–1 de 2 productos; Página 1 de 2; Anterior visually disabled, Siguiente enabled.

scenarios.name: click-next-reaches-last-page
scenarios.visible: Mostrando 2–2 de 2 productos; Página 2 de 2; Anterior enabled, Siguiente visually disabled. This is the last page; no separate Última/Last control was visible.

scenarios.name: change-search-from-page-1
scenarios.visible: Search changed through the header search input from “G6 QA Marketplace Desempate” to “G6 QA Marketplace”; URL omitted page, response pageNumber=0, and UI showed Página 1 de 2.

scenarios.name: out-of-range-page-2
scenarios.visible: “ESTA PÁGINA YA NO TIENE PRODUCTOS”; “Página 3 de 2”; Anterior enabled, Siguiente visually disabled; actions “Limpiar búsqueda” and “Ver catálogo completo”. No explicit action to return to page zero while preserving q was visible.

criteria.firstThenNextAndLastPage: Verified through one click of Siguiente: page 0 → page 1 (the last page, totalPages=2). No separate Última control was present.
criteria.pageUrlAndPageNumber: Verified: page omitted defaults to pageNumber=0; clicking Siguiente adds page=1; UI labels pages 1/2 and 2/2.
criteria.totalsAndNoDuplicates: Verified two products, totalElements=2, totalPages=2; IDs differ across the two observed pages (ord-002 then ord-001).
criteria.searchChangeResetsPage: Verified from page=1: submitting a shorter query through the UI removed page from URL, kept pageSize=1, and the response/UI returned to pageNumber=0 / page 1 of 2.
criteria.filterChangeResetsPage: Not verified; no filter inputs/controls were present in the rendered DOM. The only input was the labeled search field.
criteria.outOfRangeApi: Verified: UI-originated response is HTTP 200/REAL with page=2, size=1, totalElements=2, totalPages=2 and an empty product list.
criteria.outOfRangeVisual: Controlled empty state rendered and no automatic redirect occurred. V-006-OPEN-03 is NOT MET in this UI cut: the page displays “Página 3 de 2” and offers “Limpiar búsqueda” / “Ver catálogo completo”, but no explicit return-to-page-zero action preserving search criteria. Siguiente is disabled.
criteria.noAutomaticRetry: No repeated requests were sent by the test; one page-generated products request was observed per scenario.

separateDependencyEvidence.BE61: Per the previously reviewed Backend #61 retest, an APIM case for page=2,size=1 returned HTTP 200/REAL, data=[], page=2, totalElements=2,totalPages=2, request ID 297754b6-b1f4-4786-8505-bf7031aec24b. That is separate backend evidence, not part of this UI run and not retested here.
separateDependencyEvidence.FE35: Implementation is in merged Frontend #124; independent acceptance remains separate.

result: PARTIAL / NOT READY for FE #36 acceptance: pagination between the two known products and search reset were verified. Filter reset was unavailable. The out-of-range API response is correct, but the published UI misses the explicit OPEN-03 action to return to page zero while preserving q and shows Página 3 de 2.
issueState: open; no state change requested or made.
sanitization: No cookies, credentials, authorization headers, HAR, or personal data were recorded.
